title: IC CORPORATION: AMTRAN/STEERING COLUMN (253 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH 2-PIECE, NO5X7508 TILTING STEERING COLUMN, OR NO5X710 TELESCOPIC AND TILTING STEERING COLUMN.  THE UPPER PINCH BOLT NUT WAS OMITTED DURING THE ASSEMBLY PROCESS.  IF THE NUT WAS NOT INSTALLED, THE BOLT CAN SEPARATE FROM THE UNIVERSAL JOINT.

title: Strick Trailers, LLC: STRICK/RHP SUSPENSIONS (30 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH MERITOR RHP SUSPENSIONS.  THESE TRAILERS EXCEED THE BRAKE ACTUATION AND RELEASE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: Trailers by Dorsey, Inc.: DORSEY/FMVSS 106 BRAKE HOSES (1,534 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PLATFORM TRAILERS AND DOLLIES.  THE TUBING INSTALLED IN THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM ON THE PLATFORM TRAILERS WAS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR USE WITH THE TUBING FITTINGS USED IN THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM AND THE TUBING INSTALLED ON THE DOLLIES DOES NOT HAVE THE PROPER LABELING AND MINIMUM BURST STRENGTH.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 106, "BRAKE HOSES."

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: SUBARU/PUROLATOR OIL FILTERS (20,306 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES, ALSO SERVICE PARTS SUPPLIED TO SUBARU DEALERS ARE INVOLVED (LOT NUMBERS F01 J21D2, F01 J30D2, F02 J09D1, F02 J09D2, AND F02 J20D1).  THE PUROLATOR OIL FILTER CANS USED ON THESE VEHICLES CAN FRACTURE CAUSING A VAPORIZED OIL SPRAY AND SUBSEQUENT OIL LEAK.

title: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN/TRANSFER CASE (6 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  LOCKUP OF THE TRANSFER CASE CAN OCCUR DUE TO INSUFFICIENT LUBRICATION.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: PACCAR/ELECTRICAL/FUEL LINE ROUTING (9,500 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH CATERPILLAR 3406E ENGINES.  THE ROUTING OF THE ELECTRICAL AND FUEL LINES CAN CAUSE CHAFFING OF THE WIRING HARNESS ON THE FUEL LINE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 102 (38,540 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MINI VANS.  THESE VEHICLES MAY HAVE (1) A BROKEN SHIFT CABLE FITTING OR (2) LOOSE SHIFT LINKAGE.  CONSEQUENTLY, MOVING THE SHIFT LEVER TO A 'PARK' POSITION MAY NOT SHIFT THE TRANSMISSION TO 'PARK'.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/FUEL SEALS (84,600 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES BUILT WITH 3.3L ENGINES.  THE 'O-RINGS' USED TO SEAL THE INTERFACE OF THE FUEL INJECTOR RAIL SUPPLY, RETURN AND CROSS OVER TUBES ARE NOT AS ROBUST AS THOSE USED IN LATER MODEL YEARS.  DETERIORATION OF THE 'O-RINGS' CAN CAUSE FUEL LEAKAGE.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: FERRARI/POWER STEERING COLUMN (235 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE TORQUE ON THE POWER STEERING COLUMN NUT IS INSUFFICIENT.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/ACCURIDE/ALUMINUM DUAL WHEELS (3,041 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH AFTERMARKET ALUMINUM DUAL WHEELS, 22.5X8.25, ONE-PIECE, TUBELESS, SUPPLIED BY ACCURIDE/AKW.  CERTAIN DESIGN REVISIONS COMBINED WITH PROCESS CONDITIONS CAUSED FATIGUE CRACKS IN THESE WHEELS.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: VW/INTAKE AIR SCREEN (19,800 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  IF THE ENGINE BACKFIRES DURING A COLD-START, AN AIR SCREEN WHICH IS LOOSELY SEATED IN THE AIR FLOW METER CAN BECOME DAMAGED.

title: Lotus Cars Limited: LOTUS/WHEELS (160 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  CERTAIN WHEELS WERE NOT PROPERLY HEAT TREATED FOR HARDNESS.   THE REAR WHEELS COULD CRACK AND BREAK.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/REAR AXLE DIFFERENTIAL (1,100 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE DIFFERENTIAL PINION SHAFT WITHIN THE DIFFERENTIAL CASE ASSEMBLY WAS PRODUCED WITHOUT THE APPROPRIATE SURFACE HARDENING.  THIS CAN RESULT IN THE SHAFT EXPERIENCING PREMATURE WEAR.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/TRANSMISSION GEAR SWITCH (3,800 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE SEALING MATERIAL OF THE SWITCH CAN DEVELOP LEAKS AND ALLOW WATER ENTRY.

title: Erwin Hymer Group North America, Inc.: HOME AND PARK/FUEL VENT (404 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS 'B' MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON DODGE 1500, 2500 AND 3500 VAN CHASSIS.  THE FUELVENT HOSE FROM THE FUEL TANK TO THE FUEL FILL ENTRY MAY NOT BE VAPOR TIGHT DUE TO OVER TIGHTENING OF THE GEAR CLAMP AT THE CONNECTION OF THE PLASTIC VENT TANK OUTAGE TO THE RUBBER VENT HOSE.  THIS CAN RESULT IN FUEL OR FUEL VAPOR LEAKING.

title: redundant NEW FLYER OF AMERICA, INC.: NEW FLYER/FUEL REGULATOR (98 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH AN AUXILIARY DIESEL POWERED HEATER (PROHEAT BRAVO MODEL 80).   AN IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED FUEL REGULATOR CAN ALLOW AN EXCESS AMOUNT OF FUEL INTO THE COMBUSTION CHAMBER.

title: redundant NEW FLYER OF AMERICA, INC.: NEW FLYER/REAR BRAKES (30 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  ARTICULATED TRANSIT BUSES.  UNDER EXTREME BRAKE APPLICATIONS, THE SLACK ADJUSTER YOKE IN THE REAR BRAKES CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH THE ALXE MOUNTING HARDWARE.

title: redundant NEW FLYER OF AMERICA, INC.: NEW FLYER/FMVSS 207 (163 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT BUSES.   A TETHER STRAP ON THE DRIVER'S SEAT WAS OMITTED.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE STRENGTH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 207, SEATING SYSTEMS."

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: SAAB/FMVSS 208 (39,313 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE AIR BAG ALERT LABEL ON THE DRIVER SIDE VISOR WAS OMITTED.  THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: Jayco, Inc.: JAYCO/ENGINE FIRE (208 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MINI MOTOR HOMES.  THE ROUTING OF THE WIRE LOOM IN THE ENGINE IS TOO CLOSE TO THE ENGINE BLOCK.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: SUZUKI/FUEL GASKET (17,007 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  THE GASKET BETWEEN THE FUEL TANK AND THE FUEL PUMP MOUNTING PLATE CAN LOSE ITS ABILITY TO PROVIDE A TIGHT SEAL, ALLOWING FUEL TO DRIP FROM THE GASKET.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FRONT COIL SPRINGS (281,000 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL REGULATION 573.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.  VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES ORIGINALLY SOLD OR CURRENTLY REGISTERED IN THE STATES OF NEW YORK, MICHIGAN, OHIO, ILLINOIS, WISCONSIN, PENNSYLVANIA, MASSACHUSETTS, INDIANA, NEW JERSEY, MAINE, CONNECTICUT, NEW HAMPSHIRE, RHODE ISLAND, VERMONT, MINNESOTA, IOWA, MISSOURI, KENTUCKY, MARYLAND, DELAWARE, AND WEST VIRGINIA.  FORD IS PROVIDING AN EXTENDED WARRANTY THROUGH THE YEAR 2001 FOR REPLACEMENT OF FRON TSPRINGS DUE TO FRACTURE.  THE FRONT COIL SPRINGS CAN FRACTURE AS A RESULT OF CORROSION IN COMBINATION WITH SMALL CRACKS IN THE SPRINGS.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 104 (1,059 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR 'LOW' SPEED FUNCTION CAN BECOME INOPERATIVE WHEN THE MOTOR IS SWITCHED FROM 'HIGH' TO 'LOW' SPEED.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/SEAT LATCH/FINGER INJURIES (125,990 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER MINI VANS EQUIPPED WITH BUCKET SEATS OR A SPLIT BENCH SEAT IN THE SECOND (MIDDLE) OR THIRD (BACK) ROW.  THE SEAT LATCH MECHANISMS ON BUCKET SEATS AND ON THE 40% PORTION OF THE SPLIT BENCH SEAT IN THE SECOND AND THIRD ROWS DO NOT HAVE PROTECTIVE COVERS.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FLEETWOOD/FMVSS 205 (895 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOMES.  THE DRIVER'S AND PASSENGER'S SIDE WINDOWS DO NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 205, "GLAZING MATERIALS," FOR AN ACCEPTABLE LEVEL OF TINT.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT (675,302 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.   BECAUSE OF CERTAIN CALIBRATIONS IN THE AIR BAG'S SENSING AND DIAGNOSTIC MODULE, AN INADVERTENT AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT COULD OCCUR IN A LOW SPEED CRASH OR WHEN AN OBJECT STRIKES THE FLOOR PAN.
